title: 2019 HMMT February Guts Problem M_{7}
statement: Let \(A=\left\lceil\log _{2} M_{4}\right\rceil, B=M_{12}+1\). A 5 -term sequence of positive reals satisfy that the first three terms and the last three terms both form an arithmetic sequence and the middle three terms form a geometric sequence. If the first term is \(A\) and the fifth term is \(B\), determine the third term of the sequence.

solutions.text:
\(\frac{40}{3}\)

\(A=20, B=8\). If the middle term is \(x\), then \((x+20) / 2, x,(x+8) / 2\) forms a geometric series.This means that \((x+20) / 2 \cdot(x+8) / 2=x^{2}\), which upon solving gives \(x=40 / 3\) or \(x=-4\) (which we discard because \(x>0\) ).
